QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` both default to off (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` and `:2196`). ... Every mutex call I checked sits behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both macros and states that mutex code is gated behind `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`, with THREADING_PTHREAD named alongside it as a config option that defaults to off.
